install: Add "@pixling/opencode-proxy" to the "plugin" array in opencode.json
proxy.how: A plugin in the OpenCode process: each text part shows as it ends, session.idle shows the reply, permission events ask on the resident, and what the user writes is sent with session.promptAsync.

docs.summary: Add @pixling/opencode-proxy to OpenCode: replies show on the resident, and what you write there reaches the session.
